title: Gerresheimer
summary: German maker of glass and plastic packaging and delivery devices for drugs.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Gerresheimer supplies vials, syringes, inhalers and injection devices to pharma and biotech, with a growing focus on high-value delivery systems for biologics and GLP-1 therapies. It has been expanding moulded-glass and device capacity. Energy costs and customer concentration affect margins.

Technology Exposure

  • Moulded and tubular glass packaging
  • Injection and inhalation devices
  • Medical plastic systems

What To Watch

  • GLP-1 device demand
  • Energy costs
  • Capacity utilisation

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
